exam_scheme.note: Bhabha Atomic Research Centre conducts the OCES/DGFS recruitment for engineering graduates and science post-graduates through a two-stage process. Stage 1 is screening either through an Online Computer Based Test (CBT) conducted by BARC across major cities, or through a valid GATE score (cut-off score declared separately per discipline). Shortlisted candidates from both channels proceed to Stage 2: a rigorous in-person Technical Selection Interview conducted at BARC Training School, Anushaktinagar, Mumbai. Final selection is based 100% on performance in the Selection Interview, subject to medical fitness.

financial_package.note: During the 1-year OCES training, Trainee Scientific Officers (TSOs) receive a monthly stipend of ₹55,000 plus a one-time book allowance of ₹18,000 with furnished institutional accommodation. On successful completion, trainees are absorbed as Scientific Officer (Grade C), Group A Gazetted under the 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 10 (Entry Basic ₹56,100). Scientific officers are entitled to central allowances, Performance Related Incentive Scheme (PRIS), and Contributory Health Service Scheme (CHSS).
